chapter.verse: Tua ahihleh cilesa lam pan ka pupi uh Abraham in bang ngahkhia ahi hiam?
A hang pen Abraham a sepna tawh diksakna ngah hileh a kisialh theih nading thu om a, ahi zongin Pasian' mai-ah tua bang om lo hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian' Laibupi in bang gen ahi hiam? “Abraham in Pasian um a, tua pen ama' adingin diktatna ci-in kisimsak hi,” ci hi.
Tu-in na a sem mi khat in thaman a ngah pen amah a kiguaihna hi a, hehpihna-in kisim lo hi.
Na a semlo mi khat in Pasian pen kihtakbei misiate a diksakpa ci-in a up leh ama' upna pen diktatna ci-in kisimsak hi.
Tua pen Pasian in gamtatna kal lo-in a diktat ci-in a simsak mite' thupha ngahzia hi a, a nuai-a David' genna bang lian ahi hi:
“Thukhun pampaihna a septe uh a kimaisak mite, a mawhna uh a kiseelcipsak mite thuphangah hi a,
Topa in a mawhna a ciaptehsakloh mi thuphangah ahi hi.”
Tua ahihleh hih David' gen thupha pen vun-at mite bek' ading hiam, ahihkeileh vun-atloh mite' ading zong ahi hiam? Banghanghiam cihleh upna pen Abraham' adingin diktatna ci-in kisimsak i ci hi.
Tua ahihleh bangci bangin kisimsak hiam? Tua banga a kisimsak pen vun-at ma hiam, vun-at khit hiam? Vun-at khit hilo-in vun-at ma ahi hi.

Abraham in vun-atloh ahih laitak mahin upna tawh a ngah dikna thu lahcianna lim dingin vun-atna na sang hi. Tua pen vun-atloh thu-um mite khempeuh ii pupi a suah theih nading leh tua mite zong diksakna ngah ci-in a kisimsak theih nading ahi hi.
Tua banah vun ki-at mite, vun-atna ciang bek hilo-in i pupi Abraham vun-at ma-a a neih upna khekhap a zuite, tua mite ii pupi a suah nading zong ahi hi.
Abraham leitung gamhluah hiding cih, amah leh ama' suanlekhakte' tunga kipia kamciam pen thukhun tungtawn hilo-in upna hanga kingah diksakna tungtawn ahi hi.
Thukhun a zuite in gamhluah ding uh ahih mawk leh upna i cih zong a hawmpi suakin kamciam zong bangmah manlo hiding hi.
A hang pen thukhun in hehna piangsak a, ahi zongin thukhun om kei peuhleh thukhun palsatna zong om tuanlo hi.

Hih thu hangin tua kamciam pen hehpihna tunga kinga ahih nadingin leh Abraham' suanlekhakte' adingin zong—thukhun a zuite bek hilo, eite khempeuh' pupi ahi Abraham' upna nam a nei mite' adingin zong—a muantaak ahih nadingin tua kamciam pen upna tungah a kinga ahi hi.

(Pupi cih ciangin “Minam tampite' pupi dingin nang kong bawl khinzo hi,” ci-a kigelh mah bangin) Abraham pen ama' up Pasian—misite nuntakna guanin a omlo nate zong a min lokhia-in a omsak—tua Pasian' ompihna sungah eite' pupi ahi hi.
Ama' tunga kigensa, “Na suanlekhakte zong tua bang hiding hi,” cihna thu bangin Abraham in minam tampite' pupi suah nading lamet-huai lo pi mah lamenin um hi.
A pumpi (amah kum zakhat kiim pha ta ahih manin) misi tawh kibang ahihlam leh Sarah' naubu zong a si tawh kibang ahihlam thei ahih hangin upna thu ah amah thanem tuanlo hi.
Pasian' kamciamna vai ah muanlahna tawh lunghiang cih bang om lo a, Pasian' min phatin upna thu ah thakhauh semsem hi.
Pasian in a piaksa kamciam sem zo mahmah ahihlam telcian hi.
Tua hang mahin zong ama' upna pen ama' adingin diktatna ci-in a kisimsak ahi hi.
Ahi zongin “ama' adingin...kisimsak” ci-in a kigelh pen Abraham' ading bek hilo a,
eite' ading zong ahi hi. Misite lakpan Jesu i Topa a thokiksakpa a um eite zong tua bangin hong kisimsak ding hi.
Tua Jesu in eite' tatkhialhnate hangin apna thuakin diksakna i ngah nadingin amah kithokiksak hi.
